theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: Energy is the only top-5 theme with both a strong durability_bar (0.62) and broad participation (breadth 0.636), and it is not crowded (crowding_z 0.93, below the crowded flag). The absolute-trend gate is satisfied (eligible true), and this is the one leg with validated drawdown protection. The rotation margin to the leader is narrow (0.185), suggesting a durable challenger rather than a one-narrative move.
theses.dissent: Energy is a mean-reverting-prone complex and the Hurst tag is 'mixed,' not a clean trend; the cross-sectional momentum rank itself has ~zero forward edge, so this is a breadth/durability read, not a return forecast.
